name: Jim Crow of the North Stories
original_name: Jim Crow of the North Stories
overview: How have Minnesotans responded to the rising awareness of racist covenants, red lining, and other forms of damaging segregation? This digital series uncovers this dark history of systemic racism, but also lifts up Black resistance in the past and the present-day changemakers bringing it to light and looking to right historical housing injustices.
